title: Burchett's 'five to seven undersea bases' claim traced to the email

tellings.quote: what I think happened is someone who'd seen that email is the one who talked to Burchett.

plain: A congressman named Tim Burchett has spoken of "five to seven undersea bases", meaning hidden bases under the ocean, and a retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet thinks he knows where Burchett got the idea. Gallaudet says it goes back to an email written by a commander in naval intelligence, and that "someone who'd seen that email is the one who talked to Burchett." He gives this as his own reading of events and names no one who told him so, and the telling does not say what the email itself contained.
